name: OpusClip
tagline: Turn long videos into short clips for social media
description: OpusClip finds the best moments in a long recording, reframes them to vertical, adds captions and a score, then schedules them to your social channels.
priceNote: Starter is $15/month, Pro is $29/month or $14.50/month billed annually ($174 per year) with 300 credits, Business is quoted, and the free plan is capped at about 60 minutes a month with a watermark. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Creators and marketers who need many short clips out of long videos
pros: Clip detection reliably finds the quotable moments in a podcast, webinar or stream
Auto reframe keeps the speaker centred when landscape footage has to become vertical
Captions, stock B-roll and a royalty-free score are applied without leaving the editor
Scheduling pushes finished clips to the social accounts you connect, with captions
cons: The free plan watermarks exports and caps you at roughly 60 minutes of processing a month
Credit limits mean a backlog of long videos can burn through the monthly allowance fast
Clips sometimes cut mid-sentence, so every output still needs a human review pass
Social publishing covers only the platforms it supports and is not a full content calendar

features.name: Clip detection
features.detail: Scores and pulls the strongest moments out of long recordings

features.name: Auto reframe
features.detail: Reframes landscape footage to vertical while tracking the speaker

features.name: Captions and B-roll
features.detail: Styled captions, stock B-roll and royalty-free music in one pass

features.name: Virality score
features.detail: Ranks each clip by predicted performance before you export it

features.name: Social scheduling
features.detail: Publishes clips to connected accounts with captions and hashtags

features.name: Team workspace
features.detail: Shared brand presets and clip libraries for small content teams

useCases: Post five short clips from every podcast episode without hiring an editor
Turn customer webinar recordings into sales clips for the company website
Batch social content for a small brand with one recording session a week
Repurpose long founder interviews into clips for the company newsletter
bestForWho: Podcasters, educators and marketers who already record long video and need many short clips out of it.
verdict: OpusClip is the shortcut for anyone who already records long video and treats short clips as a chore. Clip detection does the tedious part, finding the moments worth cutting, and auto reframe handles the vertical crop that most tools get wrong when a speaker moves. The result still needs a human pass, because the detector sometimes cuts mid-sentence, but you are reviewing ten candidates instead of editing a timeline. The credit allowance is the part to watch: a backlog of hour-long interviews will eat a month of processing in a week. Free exports carry a watermark, so a paid plan is effectively required the moment you publish, and for a creator or agency with a steady stream of long recordings the time saved pays for it in the first month.
